name: Narusawa (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Narusawa village emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain and a character.
history: Municipal flag of Narusawa, a village in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Narusawa village emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised mountain and a character
